distinguishing_features: Metal-to-metal lip seal replacing elastomeric O-ring
Self-energizing via differential thermal expansion between lip and body
Use of Invar body to create CTE mismatch with steel lip
Passive thermal mechanism generating contact pressure under thermal cycling
parsed.objective_technical_problem: How to maintain a reliable seal in a subsea hydraulic connector under pressure and thermal cycling without relying on elastomeric seals that degrade.
parsed.viable_reason: The mechanism requires a temperature differential between lip and body (ΔT=50 K) that does not exist in a subsea connector, where the lip and body are at the same temperature during thermal cycling, so no differential expansion force is generated.
parsed.non_obvious_reason: Since the mechanism is physically infeasible as written, it cannot be considered an inventive step over the prior art.
